label: Win/Loss Analysis
description: Analyse won and lost deals to identify patterns, improve sales effectiveness, and refine go-to-market strategy. Covers individual deal analysis, trend identification, and systematic improvement recommendations.

options.label: Analyse a specific win or loss

guidedInputs.label: Analysis period
guidedInputs.description: For a multi-deal analysis: the period the deals cover.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. Q1–Q3 2026, or rolling 12 months to September 2026

guidedInputs.label: Overall win rate (if known)
guidedInputs.description: The headline rate for the period, so findings can be read against it.

guidedInputs.label: Deal information
guidedInputs.description: For single deal analysis, describe the deal. For trend analysis, describe the dataset or upload a spreadsheet.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Lost EUR 400k AML advisory deal to Deloitte at Nordic bank. We were the incumbent, client said our proposal lacked innovation. 3-month sales cycle, met 4 stakeholders, submitted detailed proposal.

guidedInputs.label: Client feedback (if available)
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Client said they valued our expertise but felt Deloitte offered a more structured methodology and better technology tools. Price was similar.

guidedInputs.label: Sales process followed
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Initial meeting from conference networking, 2 discovery calls, site visit, proposal submission, presentation to steering committee, lost after final round

guidedInputs.label: What do you want to learn?
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Why do we keep losing to Big 4 in competitive situations? Are we qualifying deals properly? Is our proposal format effective? What are our top 3 improvement areas?
